items.statement: The submitted model uses a 3x3 MoS2(001) slab with 15 Å vacuum and one Ni replacing a Mo site, with explicit active sulfur identity.
items.expected: Composition, surface orientation, supercell, vacuum, substitution and active-site identity are explicitly evidenced.

items.statement: The submission validates the associative four-step CHE bookkeeping and identifies the potential-determining step from ΔG1–ΔG4.
items.expected: Four named proton/electron steps, U=0 V/pH=0/T=298.15 K, corrections and PDS selection are reported.

items.statement: For Ni@MoS2 the reported ORR overpotential is 0.53 V.
items.expected: η is reported as a numeric value in volts for the identified Ni@MoS2 active-site model.

items.statement: For Ni@MoS2 the reported active sulfur p-band center is −1.24 eV.
items.expected: εp is reported as a numeric value in eV for the identified active sulfur.
